prose_word_change.heuristic: Count whitespace-delimited tokens containing a Unicode letter after stripping unescaped comments, citation/reference/label commands, inline and display mathematics, and mathematical environments. Remove remaining TeX command names and environment wrappers while retaining ordinary argument text; remove grouping braces, replace nonbreaking spaces with spaces, split em dashes, and retain hyphenated compounds as one token.
